transport.association_window: READ1_RESPONSE 110-170 ps for four-BVM; per-run protection separately uses 70-82 ps

BJ2.role: local QB output junction; not downstream reception by itself

JTL1.role: JTL output-facing B02 is primary; B01 is auxiliary/internal

JTL2.role: JTL output-facing B02 is primary; B01 is auxiliary/internal

JTL3.role: JTL output-facing B02 is primary; B01 is auxiliary/internal

JTL4.role: JTL output-facing B02 is primary; B01 is auxiliary/internal

JTL5.role: JTL output-facing B02 is primary; B01 is auxiliary/internal

JTL6.role: JTL output-facing B02 is primary; B01 is auxiliary/internal

transport.warning: local B02 events are not automatically matched cross-junction identities; onset order and polarity are descriptive checks

orientation.convention: positive current is from the first listed deck node to the second
orientation.node_2: BJs 1->2 enters; BJ1/RJ1 2->0 and L1 2->BIAS leave
orientation.node_bias: L1 2->BIAS and I_QB_BIAS 0->BIAS enter; L2 BIAS->4 leaves
orientation.node_4: L2 BIAS->4 enters; BJ2/RJ2 4->0 and L3 4->OUT leave

settling.boundedness_observation: descriptive; no single voltage threshold is used as a retrapping proof

post_settling.boundedness_observation: descriptive; no single voltage threshold is used as a retrapping proof

four_bvm_summary.warning: four-BVM net phase trajectory and local/JTL event summaries remain separate; no four/five net-turn claim is an SFQ count

analysis_boundaries.observed: raw/grid, phase/area segments, waveform and KCL arithmetic
analysis_boundaries.derived: window-assigned complete/clean local segments and onset/latency summaries
analysis_boundaries.inference: exploratory branch/protection labels only after comparison; not a Gate; descriptive candidate bounds are post-hoc
analysis_boundaries.unknown: paper mechanism identity, canonical BVM compatibility, timestep convergence beyond tested pair

warnings: P(...) is raw JoSIM radians; turns are only continuous_unwrap(rad)/(2*pi)
local JJ phase slip is not automatically downstream reception
net phase trajectory is not an SFQ count
no post-hoc parameter tuning was performed; strict-event tolerances are pre-registered in experiment.yaml, while candidate and approximately-one-Phi0 bounds are descriptive post-hoc analysis aids
